classification: Research scenarios only; arrays bear/base/bull. Patient count is a financially accessible candidate population, not verified prevalence. All sales/price/share/launch/p/netRate are research assumptions; issuer identity, qualitative own-development or licensing and stage evidence remain separately in register.
method: peakUSDbn=patients*annualRealizedProductPriceUSD*share/1e9. For retained products netRate is research realization after hypothetical channels/license leakage; GM deducts production costs, incremental selling and all original clinical budgets are additional. For licensed royalties netRate is research royalty and GM reflects limited direct servicing costs, not full manufacture. No future unknown development milestone added.
probabilityPolicy: Reference phase I-to-approval overall about7.9%, oncology lower and validated non-oncology higher; candidate research values incorporate stage and direct evidence, not literal phase-average predictions. China IPF phase III base45% discounts small safety-primary IIa, 12-week followup, attrition and FVC missingness. US inactive and overseas unstarted pathways have lower probability and later launch; no target-year readout assumed before registered2029-10-30.
costPolicy: All nine legacy annual clinical cost totals are preserved in unallocated clinicalUnallocated, including active rows; row cost0 prevents fabricated allocation. Does not prove budget adequacy; +30% and +100% cost sensitivities required. Same molecule/indication regions never duplicate early trial costs.
ownershipPolicy: Internal/wholly-owned supports ownership1 research assumption, not unencumbered exact net right proof; Hygtia/Fosun50% follows disclosed economic interests. 0/50/100% retained-ownership and 0/50/100% licensed royalty sensitivities required with costs held unchanged.
overlapPolicy: IPF oral China, US, other territories disjoint. Inhaled uses only incrementally eligible/oral-intolerant patients, excludes oral addressable pool; no simultaneous full global market. UC geographic groups disjoint; CD separate diagnosis. MAT2A3412 selected MTAP-deleted non-GBM solid tumor pool explicitly excludes GBM reserved for0387; same eligible patient is not counted twice. Broad biomarker cancer rows defined as selected biomarker population, not every cancer type. TEAD other tumors/ENPP1/NLRP broad undeclared diseases and unspecified PCC directions remain zero where individual indication or region stage mapping insufficient.
geographicResearchPolicy: Explicit CN/US/OTHER rows disjoint; other disease, CD, PD, oncology and early PCC rows use one China plus potentially overseas financially accessible population research sum, not complete region-by-region rNPV. T2D non-obesity extensions are unverified research beyond obesity-related announcement context and must be zeroed if unsupported.
correlationPolicy: Same molecule across indication or territory shares safety/CMC risk; p values are marginal research weighting only, never independent joint approval probabilities. GIPR and MAT2A disjoint research pools require evidence to validate.
earlyPolicy: PCC candidates with explicit disease and own-development identity have separately sized narrow demand; broad unnamed disease groups remain zero. ISM0676/1354 obesity pools are differentiated combo segments, not two complete GLP1 global markets. NR3C1 hypercortisol obesity is not general obesity. Early probabilities discount absence of human disease evidence.
